editorial.heading: One simple tool to save public social media videos
editorial.subheading: Download your videos and audio tracks in their original quality, for free and without creating an account.
paragraphs: VIDNEX is a free web tool that lets you save publicly shared videos from TikTok, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), and Facebook straight to your device. Your video is never re-encoded or stamped with extra logos: you get the original MP4, JPG, or MP3 file directly.

Simply paste a public link into the box above. Within seconds, VIDNEX finds the available quality options (such as 1080p HD, 720p, or standard definition) so you can save the file to your phone or computer. No files are ever stored on our servers.

On TikTok, you can save videos without the moving watermark, download photo slideshows, or extract MP3 audio. On Instagram, VIDNEX supports public Reels, multi-photo carousels (with one-click ZIP download), and full-size profile pictures. On X and Facebook, it saves public videos and Reels in HD or SD.
formatsList: TikTok: watermark-free MP4 video, Photo Mode JPG slideshows, and original MP3 audio.
Instagram: public Reels in MP4, multi-slide photo/video carousels (.ZIP), and HD profile pictures.

Facebook: public Watch videos, fb.watch shortlinks, and Facebook Reels in HD or SD MP4.

about.metaTitle: About VIDNEX — Stateless Public Media Resolver
about.metaDescription: Learn how VIDNEX resolves public videos across TikTok, Instagram, X, and Facebook using a stateless web architecture with zero file storage.
about.intro: VIDNEX is an independent web utility built to make saving public social media videos and public profile photos from TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook, and LinkedIn straightforward and transparent.

sections.heading: How VIDNEX works
paragraphs: Saving a public clip for offline reference or archiving your own social videos without mobile watermarks shouldn't require installing untrusted desktop software. VIDNEX provides a clean browser interface that works across phones, tablets, and computers without registration.

Under the hood, VIDNEX acts as an on-demand public metadata resolver. When you submit a public URL, our system inspects the public metadata of the post and proxies the direct media stream from the origin CDN to your browser.

sections.heading: Zero file hosting and strict privacy boundaries
paragraphs: VIDNEX does not operate a media archive: we never host, store, or index video, audio, or image files on our servers. Every stream is relayed in volatile memory.
We strictly limit extraction to public posts accessible without authentication. VIDNEX never bypasses login walls, private accounts, or digital rights management controls.

privacy.metaDescription: Read the VIDNEX Privacy Policy: ephemeral URL processing, zero video storage on disk, hashed anti-abuse counters, and AdSense disclosures.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains clearly and honestly what technical data VIDNEX processes when you use our website.

sections.heading: 1. Ephemeral URL processing and zero video storage
paragraphs: When you paste a public URL into VIDNEX, the link is processed in memory by our `/api/extract` endpoint solely to resolve the direct media stream. Downloaded videos, audio tracks, and images are streamed through memory and are never written to disk.

To monitor engine health and enforce per-minute rate limits against automated abuse, our internal database records only aggregated technical telemetry: target platform name, status (success or error code), response duration in milliseconds, and a one-way salted SHA-256 hash of the client IP address. Raw IP addresses and submitted URLs are not stored in request logs.

sections.heading: 2. Browser localStorage preferences
paragraphs: VIDNEX uses browser localStorage exclusively to remember your interface preferences, such as Light/Dark theme selection and your preferred display language.

sections.heading: 3. Advertising cookies and Google AdSense
paragraphs: To keep VIDNEX free for users, we may display advertisements served by Google AdSense when advertising is enabled.

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites. Users may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com).

paragraphs: VIDNEX does not store or host any video, audio, or image files on its infrastructure. All media streams are served directly by the origin social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn). To remove content from the internet permanently, it must be removed or set to private on the source platform.

sections.heading: 2. How to request URL or creator blocklisting
paragraphs: Rights holders who wish to prevent specific public URLs or domains from being resolved through VIDNEX can request immediate inclusion in our administrative blocklist.

Please send a notice to compliance@vidnex.space containing: (1) identification of the copyrighted work, (2) the exact public URL(s) to block, and (3) your contact details along with a good-faith statement that you are the copyright owner or authorized agent.
